user.title: Connect to llama.cpp
user.description: Enter the address of your llama-server or compatible router. Start llama-server with --jinja so chat templates and JSON schemas are handled correctly.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Used as a Bearer token for llama-server, llama-swap, or an authenticating reverse proxy.
Optional. Leave empty to remove authentication.

reauth_confirm.title: Update llama.cpp authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The server at {url} rejected the current credentials. Enter a valid API key, or leave it empty if the server no longer requires authentication.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check that llama-server or the router is running and reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the API key or the authentication settings on the server or reverse proxy.
error.invalid_server: The address responded, but does not expose the llama.cpp endpoints this integration needs.

set_options.title: AI task options
set_options.description: The server reports {model} with a context size of {n_ctx} tokens. New AI Tasks default to the selected model name; a title you rename later is preserved.

data_description.model: Used as the default title when the AI Task is created. Multi-model routers are not assigned an arbitrary first model.
data_description.prompt: Added to the system prompt for every task. Rendered as a Home Assistant template, so {{ states('sensor.example') }} works.
data_description.max_tokens: Structured answers need enough room; the request fails if the model is cut off.
data_description.temperature: Lower values give more repeatable results. 0.2-0.5 works well for data tasks.
data_description.thinking: Only affects hybrid reasoning models. Thinking and constrained JSON output do not combine well.
data_description.attachments: Attachments are offered automatically when the server reports vision or audio support. Turn this on for builds that do not report their modalities. Either way llama-server must be started with a multimodal projector (--mmproj).
